info.title: Kite read model
info.description: The read side of a Kite project. Listings are paged by opaque cursor; there is no offset. When the server has an account configured, every endpoint but setup, sign-in and this description needs a session. A server that has not been set up yet answers nothing else at all until it has.

get.summary: Describe the person using the studio and how they sign in.
Read the picture shown beside the name.

put.summary: Choose the picture: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, up to 1 MB.

200.description: The account as it now is.

403.description: The request came from another site.

200.description: The account as it now is.

403.description: The request came from another site.

put.summary: Give a studio with no password one, or change the name and password of a guarded one. A change ends every other session; the caller's is issued again in Set-Cookie.

200.description: The account as it now is.

403.description: The current password is wrong, or the request came from another site.

delete.summary: Take the password away, leaving the studio open. Only a server that listens on this machine alone allows it.

200.description: The account as it now is.

403.description: The current password is wrong, or the request came from another site.

put.summary: Change the name and email address the studio shows. They are kept in .kite/secrets, never published.

200.description: The account as it now is.

403.description: The request came from another site.

delete.summary: Sign out every browser but the caller's, whose session is issued again in Set-Cookie.

200.description: The account as it now is.

403.description: The request came from another site.

get.summary: List the themes and plugins in the index the site installs from, with how the site stands with each: installed, a newer version that works with this Kite, a yanked version. A package no longer listed is left out unless the site has it. The index is fetched by this server, at most once an hour, and the copy kept is used, and said to be, when it cannot be fetched.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: theme or plugin; both when absent.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words every package listed has to match, in its id, title, description or tags.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Fetch the index even if the copy kept is less than an hour old.

get.summary: Describe a theme or a plugin in the index with every version it lists, newest first.
Read a package's icon, which this server fetches as it fetches a screenshot; an SVG is served sandboxed.

post.summary: Install a theme or a plugin from the index: the version asked for, or the newest that works with this Kite. This server fetches the archive, checks it against the sha256 the index gives and then as an uploaded one is checked, and kite.lock records where it came from. A plugin is installed turned off.

parameters.name: replace
parameters.description: Replace a theme or a plugin of the same name the site has. Without it, one the site has is answered with 409.

201.description: The package, as the site now has it.

403.description: The request came from another site.

get.summary: Read a theme's picture of itself, which this server fetches, so that a browser never has to reach the index's addresses.
Say what updating a package the site has from the index would do: the version it goes to, files changed by hand that it would replace, and what a plugin's new version does beyond what it did.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: The version to go to; the newest that works with this Kite when absent.

post.summary: Update a package the site has from the index. One whose files changed since it was installed, or a plugin whose new version does more, is updated only when the request says that was agreed to; settings stay as they are.

200.description: The package, as the site now has it.

403.description: The request came from another site.

409.description: The update needs an agreement it was not given.

post.summary: Exchange credentials for a session cookie.

200.description: The session. The cookie is in Set-Cookie.

403.description: The request came from another site.
The request came from another site.

get.summary: Report whether this server needs a sign-in, and whether the caller has one.

200.description: Whether a session is needed, and the current one.

get.summary: List content types and the field schema forms are generated from.
List content.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Content kind, repeatable.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: draft, scheduled, published or archived, repeatable.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Locale, repeatable.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Restrict to these ids, repeatable.

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: taxonomy:term the item must carry at least one of, repeatable.

parameters.name: term_all
parameters.description: taxonomy:term the item must carry all of, repeatable.

parameters.name: published_from
parameters.description: Earliest publication time, RFC 3339.

parameters.name: published_to
parameters.description: Latest publication time, RFC 3339.

parameters.name: updated_from
parameters.description: Earliest update time, RFC 3339.

parameters.name: updated_to
parameters.description: Latest update time, RFC 3339.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free text over title, excerpt and body.

parameters.name: include_deleted
parameters.description: Include soft deleted items.

parameters.name: deleted_only
parameters.description: Return only soft deleted items.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma separated keys, '-' for descending, e.g. -published_at,title.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque position from a previous response. There is no offset.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page, capped by the server.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Also report the size of the whole filtered set.

403.description: The request came from another site.

get.summary: Read one item, including its source body.

200.description: The item. ETag carries its revision.

put.summary: Replace an item, refusing an edit made against a replaced version.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The revision this edit was made against, as returned in ETag. Required: without it a save would overwrite whatever is there.

403.description: The request came from another site.

409.description: The item changed since it was loaded.

delete.summary: Move an item to the trash, keeping its files so it can be restored.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The revision this edit was made against, as returned in ETag. Required: without it a save would overwrite whatever is there.

403.description: The request came from another site.

409.description: The item changed since it was loaded.

get.summary: List the files an item keeps beside it, which are published with its page.

200.description: The item's files, by their path within its bundle.

post.summary: Store a file beside a page and report the link that reaches it.

201.description: The stored file. The name may differ from the one sent, since an upload never replaces a file of the same name.

403.description: The request came from another site.

put.summary: Put a new version of a file of a page's bundle in its place, under its name, named by its path within the bundle.

200.description: The file as it now is.

403.description: The request came from another site.

delete.summary: Remove a file from a page's bundle, named by its path within it.

403.description: The request came from another site.

post.summary: Restore an item from the trash.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The revision this edit was made against, as returned in ETag. Required: without it a save would overwrite whatever is there.

403.description: The request came from another site.

409.description: The item changed since it was loaded.

post.summary: Build the site as a deployment gets it, without drafts, and answer with it as a zip archive of what kite build writes, to upload anywhere that serves static files.

200.description: The site. Content-Disposition names the archive.

403.description: The request came from another site.

409.description: The site could not be built as it stands.

get.summary: Report how the project is linked to GitHub: where the token comes from, never the token itself, and the repository the remote points to.

put.summary: Link the project to a repository on GitHub with a fine-grained token for it, and push it there: start the repository and add origin where needed, write the deploy workflow and turn Pages on when asked, commit the site's own files and push. What would have to be refused is refused before anything changes.

403.description: The request came from another site.

409.description: The publish did not fully happen.

delete.summary: Forget the token the studio saved. One the environment gives stays.

200.description: The link as it now is.

403.description: The request came from another site.

post.summary: Store a file that belongs to the site rather than one page, such as a logo a theme setting names, in static/uploads.

201.description: The stored file. Link is its path in the site, which is what a setting holds.

403.description: The request came from another site.

get.summary: List the plugins in plugins/, including the ones that cannot be used, with why, in the language Accept-Language asks for when a plugin has a pack for it.

post.summary: Install a plugin from a zip archive holding plugin.yaml at its top or in one folder. It is checked the way a site checks it when it loads, and is not turned on: plugins.enabled in the settings does that.

parameters.name: replace
parameters.description: Replace an installed plugin of the same id. Without it, one already installed is answered with 409 and both versions.

403.description: The request came from another site.

409.description: A plugin of that id is installed already.

get.summary: Describe a plugin with its settings form and what each setting holds. ETag carries the revision of kite.yaml, for saving plugins.settings.<id>.

delete.summary: Remove an installed plugin. One that is turned on stays.

403.description: The request came from another site.

put.summary: Turn a plugin on, to run after the ones already on, or off. It changes plugins.enabled by one; one that cannot load is not turned on.

200.description: The plugin as it now is.

403.description: The request came from another site.

post.summary: Render a draft through the real theme, without storing it.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The item being edited, so its own images resolve.

403.description: The request came from another site.

post.summary: Draw the site with a theme or settings being tried, without writing anything. The preview is kept while it is used.

403.description: The request came from another site.

put.summary: Draw an open preview again with another theme or other settings.

200.description: The preview, at the same address.

403.description: The request came from another site.
The request came from another site.

get.summary: Read a page or a file of a preview. Its links lead to its other pages, drawn the same way.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Where the page or file is in the site; it may hold slashes.

get.summary: Report how far the content has traveled.

post.summary: Commit the named content, and push it when asked to.

403.description: The request came from another site.

409.description: The publish did not fully happen.

post.summary: Report what a publish would do, changing nothing.

200.description: The plan, with everything wrong with it.

403.description: The request came from another site.

post.summary: Push what is already committed, replaying it onto a remote that moved on when asked to.

403.description: The request came from another site.

409.description: The publish did not fully happen.

get.summary: Read what can be configured, and what it is set to.

200.description: The settings. ETag carries the revision of kite.yaml.

put.summary: Change configuration values by dotted path.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The revision this edit was made against, as returned in ETag. Required: without it a save would overwrite whatever is there.

schema.description: Dotted paths to values, such as site.title.

403.description: The request came from another site.

get.summary: Report whether this server still has to be set up.

200.description: Whether setup is needed, and what to fill the form with.

post.summary: Describe the site and create the account that guards it; in a folder with no site yet, create the site instead, with no account.

200.description: Set up, and signed in. The cookie is in Set-Cookie.

403.description: The request came from another site.

get.summary: Describe the open project.

post.summary: Pin this server's Kite release in kite.lock, with the sha256 of its checksums when they can be fetched, so that kitew and the deploy build the site with it.

200.description: Which release builds the site now.

403.description: The request came from another site.

get.summary: Read one term with every item that carries it, however each writes it, trashed ones included.

200.description: The term and its items. ETag fingerprints them for a rename or removal.

put.summary: Rename a term on every item that carries it, however each writes it, merging it into another term when the new name is already in use.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The revision this edit was made against, as returned in ETag. Required: without it a save would overwrite whatever is there.

parameters.description: The revision this edit was made against, as returned in ETag. Required: without it a save would overwrite whatever is there.

get.summary: List the themes the project could use: the one built into Kite, then each directory of themes/, including the ones that cannot be used, with why. What a theme says about itself is in the language Accept-Language asks for, when the theme has a language pack for it.
